title: 第2章 为达克尼斯献上
slug: 从素晴开始成为海贼王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

哗啦——！

热水剧烈翻涌，漫过浴缸边缘洒了一地。

达克尼斯的瞳孔骤然收缩，精致的脸蛋瞬间染上绯红，连最基本的防御动作都忘了施展。

这个从天而降的男人，正是被阿库娅传送过来的林北。

因为完全失去平衡，他整张脸直接埋进了两团温软的雪白之间。

慌乱中幸亏用双手撑住浴缸边缘，借力抬起身子。

否则他大概率会成为，有史以来第一个被闷死在那里的穿越者加勇者。

太丢人了！简直太丢人了！

“耶……耶……耶……夜袭！”

达克尼斯的声音颤抖得不成调子。

虽然她经常幻想这样那样的场景，可当妄想真的变成现实，身体还是本能地战栗起来。

就在她即将因过度亢奋而尖叫出声的刹那，林北挺身而上，死死堵住了她的嘴。

“咕……”

“嘘！这位小姐，请冷静！这完全是个意外！”

该死的阿库娅！为什么我的出生点会刷在别人的浴缸里？

金发碧眼，在这个世界是贵族的特征。

而眼前这位能闷死人的大美女，怎么看都是血统纯正的大贵族。

完蛋了……

“唔……唔唔！”

达克尼斯不由自主地剧烈喘息，呼出的热气不断喷洒在林北的手心手背，眼中的炽热更是早已喷薄而出。

林北慌了。

看样子她被气的不轻啊……

怎么办？

我要怎么狡辩才能获取她的信任？

这里的贵族，有很大一部分都是实力极强的天赋怪，我现在连1级冒险者都不是，干掉她会有胜算吗？

明明达克尼斯的双手活动自如，偏偏就那么凑巧，被她自己压在身下，动弹不得。

为什么？为什么会突然变成这样？这种时候明明应该反抗才对！

可身体就是完全无法行动……

难道、难道我就要在这里……

“咕……杀了我吧！”

虽然达克尼斯一直在胡思乱想，但关键时刻，她到底还是稍微清醒了一下。

再这样发展下去，自己一定会后悔的。

可就在她刚准备象征性地挣扎一下时。

林北猛地起身，以迅雷不及掩耳之势将她的脑袋按进水里。

趁这个空档，他立刻跳出浴缸，夺门而出，一个纵身从窗户翻了出去。

这种事情根本没办法解释。

就算说实话，也不会有人相信的！

当达克尼斯从水中抬起头时，整个人早已羞愤得不成样子。

“那个禽兽不如的男人，居然就这么跑了？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wow——!

The hot water surged violently, overflowing the edge of the bathtub and spilling all over the floor.

Darkness's pupils suddenly shrank, her delicate face instantly turned crimson, and she even forgot to perform the most basic defensive movements.

This man who fell from the sky was Lin Bei who was teleported here by Aqua.

Because he completely lost his balance, his entire face was buried directly between two soft white masses.

In the panic, luckily, I used my hands to support the edge of the bathtub and used the strength to lift myself up.

Otherwise, he will most likely become the first time traveler and hero to be suffocated to death there.

What a shame!It's so embarrassing!

"Yeah...yeah...yeah...night attack!"

Darkness' voice trembled uncontrollably.

Although she often fantasizes about such scenes, when the delusion actually becomes reality, her body still trembles instinctively.

Just when she was about to scream out of overexcitement, Lin Bei stepped forward and blocked her mouth.

"Gu..."

"Shh! Miss, please calm down! This is a complete accident!"

Damn Aqua!Why is my spawn point in someone else's bathtub?

Blond hair and blue eyes are the characteristics of aristocrats in this world.

And this suffocating beauty in front of me is a noble noble with pure blood.

It's over...

"Uh...uhhh!"

Darkness panted violently involuntarily, and the hot breath she exhaled continued to spray on the palms and backs of Lin Bei's hands, and the heat in her eyes had already spurted out.

Lin Bei panicked.

It looked like she was very angry...

What to do?

How can I gain her trust?

Most of the nobles here are extremely talented monsters. I'm not even a level 1 adventurer now. Do I have any chance of winning if I kill her?

Darkness's hands were obviously free to move, but by chance, they were pinned under her and unable to move.

Why?Why did it suddenly become like this?You should definitely resist at this time!

But my body is completely unable to move...

Could it be that I am going to be here...

"Gu...kill me!"

Although Darkness had been thinking wildly, at the critical moment, she finally regained consciousness.

If this continues, you will definitely regret it.

But just when she was about to struggle symbolically.

Lin Bei stood up suddenly and pushed her head into the water with lightning speed.

Taking advantage of this opportunity, he immediately jumped out of the bathtub, rushed out of the door, and jumped out of the window.

There is no way to explain this kind of thing.

Even if you tell the truth, no one will believe it!

When Darkness raised her head from the water, she was already filled with shame and anger.

"That man who was worse than a beast actually ran away like that?"
